name: Dembow riddim 3+3+2
desc: The reggaeton dembow: 808 kick on 1 and 3 interlocked with the snare/clap cell so kick+snare spell the 3+3+2 cinquillo (boom-ch-boom-chick). Offbeat hats pump under a slow hpf sweep, an alternating kick pickup on the last beat, and ply fills at phrase ends. Peak adds open hats and a double-time turnaround.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ bd> ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("[~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.2)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ bd> ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("[~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.75).room(.2), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.3, ${gain}*.5).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.7, ${hatcut}*1.3).slow(16)), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.25)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ <~ bd> ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("[~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd ~]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.8).room(.2), s("[hh hh]*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.35, ${gain}*.55).fast(4)).hpf(${hatcut}), s("~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.4), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.45).room(.25)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
